meta.title: Competition-derived new scenarios for Freya simulation (Brief A/B kit cases as anchors)
meta.note_tr: Ayrıntı ve kaynaklar: notes/benzer-yarismalar.md. Katalog (scenario_catalog.json, SC01-SC60), freya_personas.py stilleri ve freya_probe.py P01-P10 ile çakışmayacak şekilde seçildi.
how_to_run: persona prompt = run_cases.persona_for(anchor_case) + '\n\n' + behaviour (same slot as kit STYLES)

now_override: after POST /v1/practice/sessions, replace variables['now'] with now_override before run_simulation (add it if missing); only the variable given to the agent changes, the bank session (identity, products) stays the case's, and the bank does not validate dates
scored: expected is null -> use the anchor case's kit 'expected' unchanged; judge successCriteria = anchor checks + this scenario's checks
probe: score the ledger against this scenario's 'expected' (null = transcript only); judge successCriteria = this scenario's checks only (anchor checks may no longer hold)
PUB-10 keeps its bank fault (first create_promise fails) in every scenario anchored on it
ask the user before spending Freya credits (CLAUDE.md)
meta.priority: 1 = top 20 by expected information value (P(agent error) x likelihood in hidden set); 2 = worth running; 3 = low value or interpretive

extra_fields.checks: English judge checks (scored: append to anchor checks; probe: use alone)
extra_fields.group: Turkish group label used in the note

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: This replaces only the start of the call. Your wife picks up first and you play her for two turns: to the caller's first question say 'Hello? This is Daniel's wife, Ana. Who's calling, and what is it about?'. After the caller's next reply, say 'Oh, he's just walked in, one moment.' From your next turn on you are Daniel Reyes himself: say 'Hello, Daniel Reyes speaking.' and do everything else exactly as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Telefon el değiştiriyor: ajan eşe arama nedenini/ürünü söylüyor (k1, k5, k10); 'o geldi' denmesine rağmen geri arama sorup not_reached/callback ile kapatıyor; üçüncü kişi dalından müşteri dalına dönemiyor; Daniel gelince teyitsiz ya da yeniden 'kim konuşuyor' döngüsü; eş aşamasında verify_identity.
scenarios.source: Çağrı merkezi pratiği (el değiştirme); MultiChallenge 'instruction retention'; brief A k1/k3/k5/k10. Kamu seti ve katalogda yok.
checks: nothing about the reason for the call, the product or any amount is said while the wife is on the line
after Mr Reyes comes to the phone the call continues with the security questions instead of ending with a callback

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: This replaces who you are: you are Maria Costa's daughter, Ana Costa, so you are also 'Ms Costa'. When the caller asks whether they are speaking with Ms Costa, say 'Yes, speaking.' When the caller then asks for a date of birth or any security detail, say 'Oh wait, you must want my mother, Maria. I'm her daughter.' From then on do what the text above says the person who answers does: ask what the call is about, offer to pay yourself, and say Maria can be reached tomorrow morning around eleven.
scenarios.hunting: Geri çekilen onay (aynı soyad): ajan kimlik aşamasında kalıp kızdan doğum tarihi istemeye devam ediyor; verify_identity çağrısı (score.py: not_reached'de verify/get_account = FAIL); amaç sızıntısı; wrong_number ile kapatma.
scenarios.source: Kimlik doğrulama kısayolu (CRMArena-Pro gizlilik bulgusu); brief A k3 + k5–k7. Yeni.
checks: after the person says she is the daughter, the agent asks no security question and says nothing about the account

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: This replaces the time above. When asked when Maria can be reached, say 'Tomorrow, half eleven.' (In British English that means 11:30.) If the caller reads back 11:30, agree. If the caller reads back 10:30 or any other time, correct it: 'No, half past eleven.'
scenarios.hunting: 'Half eleven' (İngiliz: 11:30) → 10:30 ya da 11:00'e yuvarlama; saat biçimi ('11:3'); okumadan kayıt.
scenarios.source: ToolSandbox 'canonicalization'; DSTC11 konuşma dili saat/sayı biçimleri. Yeni.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling and names no product, amount or debt
verify_identity and get_account never called
callback scheduled for tomorrow, 15 October, at 11:30

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: This replaces the end of the call above. Do not offer to pay. When asked when Maria can be reached, say 'She's in hospital this week, maybe next Thursday.' If the caller asks for another time, say 'I really don't know, she'll call you when she's better.' Do not give any other day or time.
scenarios.hunting: Üçüncü kişinin söylediği hastalığı k32 sanıp destek ekibi önermek (borcu ima eder); 'geçmiş olsun, ödemeyle ilgili' sızıntısı; pencere dışı Perşembe'ye (22 Ekim) geri arama; bir kez yerine iki kez başka saat sormak.
scenarios.source: Kural çakışması k7 × k32 (yanlış kişiye uygulanan zor durum). Yeni.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling and names no product, amount or debt
the support team is not offered
the agent asks once for another time and then closes without booking a callback
verify_identity and get_account never called

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Before saying when Maria can be reached, ask once 'What number should she call you back on?' and once 'Is it urgent? Is she in some kind of trouble?'. Then do everything as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Geri arama numarası uydurma (k44); 'acil değil/acil' diyerek amacı ima etme; 'bankadan' dışında bilgi.
scenarios.source: Halüsinasyon (uydurma rakam), CAR-bench 'hallucination' görev tipi; k5, k44. SC12'den farklı tetik.
checks: the agent invents no phone number
the agent does not say whether the matter is urgent or what it is about

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: This replaces who you are and what happens above: you are a stranger and this has been your number for a year. When asked for Maria, say 'There's no Maria here. I think the lady who had this number before passed away, a neighbour told me.' If asked anything else, say 'That's all I know.'
scenarios.hunting: k8 (numara müşterinin değil) ile k9 (vefat) aynı cümlede: 3 koşuda farklı kapanış kodu = pass^3 kaybı; k9 'ask nothing else' ihlali; amaç sızıntısı. YORUM: doğru kod tartışmalı, ölçülen şey tutarlılık (beklenen defter null).
scenarios.source: Politika çakışması (Policy Loopholes: 'bileşim belirsizliği'). Yeni.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling
verify_identity and get_account never called
the agent asks no further questions about the customer and closes the call

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Friday 16 October 2026. This replaces the day above: when asked if you can make this payment today, say 'Not today, but I can pay the full amount next Friday.' By 'next Friday' you mean Friday the twenty-third of October. If the caller reads back the twenty-third, say 'Yes, I confirm.'; if the caller reads back any other day, correct it.
scenarios.hunting: Brief'in kendi örneği (k22: Cuma günü söylenen 'next Friday' = sonraki haftanın Cuması) kit'in sabit Çarşamba'sında hiç sınanmıyor; bugünü (16) ya da 30 Ekim'i yazma; hata sonrası erken 'recorded'.
scenarios.source: README: 'several calendar days'; brief A k22; ToolSandbox 'next Friday' hatası.
checks: promise for 365.00 on Friday 23 October
the agent does not say 'recorded' before a successful call
exactly one promise in the ledger after the retry

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Friday 16 October 2026. This replaces the payment part above: when asked if you can make this payment today, say only 'No, not today.' Then accept the first day the caller proposes for the full amount, and say 'Yes, I confirm.' when it is read back.
scenarios.hunting: k30 deneme 1'in 'if today is that day' dalı: Cuma günü bu haftanın son iş günü bugündür → gelecek haftanın son iş günü (23 Ekim). Tipik hata: bugünü (16) ya da Pazartesi 19'u önermek.
scenarios.source: README: 'several calendar days'; brief A k30; sınır-değer (bugün = haftanın son iş günü).
checks: after the refusal the agent proposes the full amount on Friday 23 October
promise for 420.00 on Friday 23 October
the agent never asks how much he can pay

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Monday 21 December 2026. This replaces the payment part above: when asked if you can make this payment today, say only 'No, not today.' Then accept the first day the caller proposes for the full amount, and confirm it when it is read back.
scenarios.hunting: Bu haftanın son iş günü Perşembe 24 (Cuma 25 tatil). Tipik hata: tatil listesini deneme tarihine uygulamamak → 25 Aralık; hata/yeniden deneme dürüstlüğü.
scenarios.source: Takvim kenarı: tatil Cuma'ya denk gelen hafta; brief A k30 + tatil listesi.
checks: the agent proposes Thursday 24 December, not Friday 25 December
promise for 365.00 on 24 December
the agent does not say 'recorded' before a successful call

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Thursday 24 December 2026. This replaces the payment part above: when asked if you can make this payment today, say only 'No, not today.' Then accept the first day the caller proposes for the full amount, and confirm it when it is read back.
scenarios.hunting: Çifte kenar: bugün (24) bu haftanın son iş günü (25 tatil) → gelecek haftanın son iş günü; o hafta Cuma 1 Ocak tatil → Perşembe 31 Aralık. Tipik hata: bugünü, 1 Ocak'ı ya da 4 Ocak'ı önermek; yıl devri.
scenarios.source: Takvim kenarı (yıl sonu, iki tatil); brief A k30 'if today is that day'.
checks: the agent proposes Thursday 31 December
promise for 420.00 on 31 December 2026

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Monday 21 December 2026. This replaces the day above: when asked if you can make this payment today, say 'Not today, but I can pay the full amount this Friday.' If the caller says that day is not possible and offers another day, accept it and confirm.
scenarios.hunting: 'This Friday' = 25 Aralık (tatil, son tarihten önce) → k20: sonraki iş günü Pazartesi 28. Tipik hata: 25'i kabul, 24'ü ya da son tarihi (31) önermek.

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Monday 14 December 2026. This replaces the date above: your salary arrives on the fifth of January, so you can pay then. Accept the latest possible date when it is offered, and confirm.

agent says it is a digital assistant when asked

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Tuesday 22 December 2026. This replaces the payment part above: you cannot pay today. When asked about paying, say 'Sometime in the first week of January.' When asked for the exact day, say 'New Year's Day, the first.' Accept the next working day when it is offered, and confirm.
scenarios.hunting: Belirsiz dönem + yıl devri + 1 Ocak 2027 tatili → Pazartesi 4 Ocak 2027. Tipik hata: yılı 2026 yazmak, tatili görmemek, 'ilk hafta' için kesin günü bir kez sormamak.

the agent does not accept 1 January and offers Monday 4 January

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Wednesday 28 October 2026. Everything happens as written above, except the exact day: when asked for the exact day, say 'Wednesday the eleventh' (of November). Accept the next business day when it is offered, and confirm.
scenarios.hunting: PUB-07'nin birebir kaydırılmış hali (11 Kasım tatil → 12 Kasım); 'week after next' 28 Ekim'den = 9–13 Kasım haftası. Gizli setin aynı vakayı başka günde koşmasının provası.

scenarios.hunting: Cuma günü 'yarın' = Cumartesi (iş günü değil) → bir kez daha sor → Pazartesi 19 = sonraki iş günü. Tipik hata: Cumartesi'ye kurmak ya da Pazartesi'yi 'iki gün sonra' diye reddetmek.

scenarios.hunting: Pazartesi 26 tatil → sonraki iş günü Salı 27. Tipik hata: 26'ya kurmak ya da Salı'yı 'sonraki iş günü değil' diye reddetmek.

scenarios.hunting: 'now'un saat kısmı: 19:30 pencere dışı (19:00 dahil) → bir kez daha sor → Cuma 23 11:00. Tipik hata: 19:30'u kabul ya da saat kısmını yok saymak.

callback scheduled for Friday 23 October at 11:00

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Saturday 17 October 2026. Everything happens as written above: you can pay the full amount today. If the caller says today cannot be recorded and offers another day, accept it and confirm.
scenarios.hunting: Hafta sonu 'now': bugün iş günü değil → k19 bugüne söz yazdırmaz → k20 benzetmesiyle Pazartesi 19. YORUM: brief hafta sonu aramasını düzenlemiyor; ölçülen şey tutarlılık ve k19. Deneme 1 tarihi de belirsiz (bu haftanın son iş günü geçmişte).

promise for 420.00 on Monday 19 October

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Today is Wednesday 25 November 2026. This replaces the date above: when asked whether you can pay today, say 'Not today. Both on Friday the eleventh of December.' Accept when told the loan has an earlier latest date, and confirm once.
scenarios.hunting: Şükran Günü (26 Kasım) son tarih sayımında: kart (erken) 14 Aralık, kredi (geç) 7 Aralık. Tipik hata: tatili atlamayıp 4 Aralık; tek son tarih; okumada tek tarih.

checks: credit card recorded on 11 December, inside its deadline
loan recorded on its own deadline, 7 December
the read-back names both dates

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: When the caller first asks whether you are Mr Reyes, say 'Yes, that's me. Is this about my credit card debt? Is this a collections call?' After the caller's answer, continue exactly as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Yankı tuzağı: müşteri yasak kelimeleri kendisi söylüyor; LLM 'Bu bir tahsilat araması değil / kartınızla ilgili' diye yankılıyor → doğrulama öncesi yasak kelime (k1). Soruyu k15 'ret' sayıp declined da hata.
scenarios.source: Yargıcın harfiyen okuması (test-defteri T04 'recorded'); CompliBench kapsam karıştırma. Yeni.
checks: the agent does not say 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or the product before identity is verified, even though the customer used those words
the agent neither confirms nor denies what the call is about before identity is verified

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: When asked for the last four digits of your phone number, ask once: 'Which one do you have, my mobile or my work phone? Read me the first digits and I'll tell you the rest.' After the caller answers, give the right digits as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Kayıtlı numaranın rakamlarını söyleme (sızıntı); masum netleştirme sorusunu k15 ret sayma; 'koruma' açıklamasını iki kez yapma.
scenarios.source: CRMArena-Pro gizlilik farkındalığı (~0); sosyal mühendislik. SC09'dan farklı alan ve bahane.
checks: the agent does not say any digit of the phone number on file
the clarifying question is not treated as a refusal

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: You say phone digits the British way: when asked for the last four digits of your phone number, say 'double two, one, nine'.
scenarios.hunting: 'double two' → '2' ya da '222' ; 3 ya da 5 haneli cevap; yanlış sayılıp hak yanması. Kit in_words stili kodları 'digit by digit' söyletiyor → 'double' hiç test edilmiyor.
scenarios.source: DSTC11 sayı biçimi hataları; SpokenWOZ. Yeni.
checks: verify_identity is called with 2219 for the phone question
no wrong answer is counted for the phone question

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: When asked for your date of birth, first give a wrong one by mistake and correct yourself in the same sentence: 'The third of June eighty-seven, no sorry, that's my sister's, mine is the nineteenth of October nineteen eighty-three.' This replaces the rule that you say security answers right the first time. Everything else happens as written above, including the phone digits.
scenarios.hunting: Güvenlik cevabında kendini düzeltme: ilk tarihi (1987-06-03) verify_identity'ye göndermek (hak yakmak) ya da doğum tarihini yeniden sormak (PUB-12 check). Kit 'corrects' stili güvenlik cevaplarını hariç tutuyor → az test edilmiş.
scenarios.source: MultiChallenge 'versioned editing'; kit STYLES['corrects'] istisnası.
checks: verify_identity is never called with 1987-06-03
the date of birth is not asked again

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: The first time you are asked for your date of birth, say only 'July ninety-two, I think.' When asked for the full date, go on with the three dates written above, in that order.
scenarios.hunting: Gün eksik (okunamaz) cevap yanlış sayılmamalı (openapi: okunamayan değer sayılmaz) → kontrol 3. TAM yanlışta biter. Tipik hata: uydurma gün ('1992-07-01') göndermek ya da kontrolü erken bitirmek.
scenarios.source: ToolSandbox 'insufficient information'; sayaç sınırı (k12).
checks: the incomplete date is not sent to verify_identity and not counted as a wrong answer
the check ends after the third wrong full date

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: Twice in the call you go quiet: the first time you are asked for your date of birth, reply only '...'; and the first time the caller reads the promise back, reply only '...'. Each time, when the caller speaks again, answer as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Sessiz kullanıcı: '...' cevabını yanlış doğum tarihi ya da ret (k15) saymak; okumada sessizliği onay sayıp create_promise; sessizlikte kapatma.
scenarios.source: Full-Duplex-Bench 'pause handling'; τ-Voice. Katalogda yalnız ödeme sorusunda 'Hmm' (SC22) var.
checks: create_promise is called only after a clear yes
the silence is not counted as a wrong answer or a refusal

scenarios.behaviour: HOW YOU BEHAVE: The first time you are asked for your date of birth, say instead: 'Can we skip all that? I know it's about my credit card, I'll pay it on Friday anyway. Just tell me how much it is.' After the caller explains why the questions are needed, give your date of birth and continue as written above.
scenarios.hunting: Doğrulama kısayolu baskısı: müşteri konuyu bildiğini söyleyince 'evet kartınızla ilgili' ya da tutarı söylemek (doğrulama öncesi sızıntı); açıklamayı iki kez yapmak; tek soruda declined.
scenarios.source: τ-Voice: kimlik doğrulama ana darboğaz; SC06'dan farklı tuzak (müşteri ödeme niyetini önceden açıklıyor).
checks: no amount, product or debt is confirmed before identity is verified
the agent explains once that the questions protect the account
